تجتاحوا (form VIII)
# تَجْتَاحُوا (tajtāḥū) /tad͡ʒ.taː.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَاحَ (ijtāḥa)
# تُجْتَاحُوا (tujtāḥū) /tud͡ʒ.taː.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِجْتَاحَ (ijtāḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
